Eva is reading a book about English. Last Monday, Eva and Sam went to the moon-lit yard. Eva likes windy days best. The spaniard ordered coffee with steamed milk.
Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Eva hopes to visit London one day. The weather was windy that day. His father is a doctor.
Sam is interested in dancing. There are always many people at the temple fair. They took many photos at the temple fair. The food here is great.
Eva and Sam had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the moon-lit yard by bike. Eva wants to be a engineer in the future.
